notes.title: UPDATE & SALE NOW ON!
notes.content:
The award-winning adventure game, Beautiful Desolation is now available in Bulgarian, Simplified and Traditional Chinese!

Beautiful Desolation was initially released in 2020 and garnered multiple awards for its distinct art, story, and setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/0529bae9e7ebff8e8ca54cb9a820e0064a1a7870.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/f010cd672d9f918d184077146cc78f0515f8b516.gif[/img]

You are flung into a futuristic, alternate-reality South Africa dominated by advanced alien technology that’s both revered and reviled. Explore, solve puzzles, make key dialogue choices and be prepared to face tough decisions in a sci-fi setting left pretty much untouched by other games. From thriving African sci-fi villages to crumbling tropical cities. Mutated forests and bone-dry ocean beds - all beautifully rendered in 2D isometric art.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/2f41ad53d3177db07b26f02a31ac48e24e188f15.gif[/img]
[b]UNFORGETTABLE FACES ALL FULLY VOICED[/b]

Humanity as you know it has been reshaped, something most evident from the characters in BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION. Technology and sentient life have become blurred. Religious zealot mechs run rife. Humans are willingly stripped of their flesh for immortality. Trans-humanistic tribes warring for power. And ruthless alien-like hunter mercenaries roaming the grasslands - to name but a few. Meet and interact with over 40 unique and bizarre characters, each fully voiced by authentic African voice actors, with thousands of lines of dialogue and multiple conversation paths. Additionally, CGI cutscenes are strewn throughout the story to bring you even closer to this enthralling sci-fi world and its characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/14f25396400135a79ff4e3f736c31e12fb34f4e9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/4c6702f8520ab683a276182bae0a1cd5152a8045.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/779d96c4f2a9f43986007619e7c0d340c4e446a7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/45b7cc72eef897478a830dec3afa406468e130f5.gif[/img]

[b]MASTERFUL MUSIC SCORE[/b]

BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION features a vibrant and highly experimental soundtrack by none other than Mick Gordon, known for his work on DOOM®, Prey®, and Wolfenstein®.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/4140f7c444ee0c4e74373fe2e0dc498f196d2fd3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/9ddfddd73f6667d45e45f0f8fe429beec5aaa009.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/b858992390f8ebf7bdb5f2e01f328764fccc58c0.jpg[/img]





[b]MORE GAMES[/b]

If you have enjoyed our games, be sure to check out our next isometric adventure game, BONE TOTEM. A nightmarish descent into the unknown depths of the ocean, the kind of horror game that stays with you even when the end credits have rolled.

notes.title: DECEMBER UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/d99873264d84f27f960d61b75aba578a12230fe4.jpg[/img]

We trust that 2019 was good to you, and we look forward to a 2020 filled with adventure games!

IF YOU HAVEN'T [i]WISHLISTED[/i] DESOLATION, CLICK '[b]ADD TO WISHLIST[/b]' BELOW

https://store.steampowered.com/app/912570/BEAUTIFUL_DESOLATION/

[b]VOICE ACTING[/b]

We've amassed a talent pool of AMAZING artists that have lent their voices to this game. Julian Casey (https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0143456/) has voiced Mark. He's best known for his roles in[b] Far Cry [/b]and the[b] Assassin's Creed[/b] series. Joining him are our usual veterans, Ryan and Glen Copper, as well as Sarah Williams (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarah_Anne_Williams) from [b]Final Fantasy[/b], [b]Persona 5 [/b]and [b]Skullgirls[/b]. 

[b]WIDE SCREEN 21:9 SUPPORT[/b]

Desolation will support native Ultra Wide Monitors. It does look pretty darn, cool at 2560 x 1080px. We'll also support 16:9 and 16:10. 

[url=https://www.thebrotherhoodgames.com/studio/screenshots-widescreen/]LINK TO HIGHER RES IMAGES[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/dda6f4fb760d12fcca1cbcece35f789ae3c59de8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/7842b013892a28a2af587637b1935a734355e701.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/9d7c8e821e9f263fa628225cfe0d03246d501d61.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/8b345c8c36d1faef9e8d698eb4915e9975f95ecd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/7cbbf66f12a323002b7c95db5d8ce96a24a70009.png[/img]

[b]LOCALIZATION[/b]

Roboto (https://roboto.global/games-localisation/) is working on the translation of Beautiful Desolation into Russian, German and French. More languages may be added once the game is released and we'd then seek partners to this end, as we did with STASIS. The translation process was built to be as simple as possible, and can be edited as an Excel Spreadsheet if needed, so we hope fans will also aid further translation!

[b]INSTAGRAM[/b]

notes.title: NEWS UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]MILESTONE REACHED[/b]

We’ve passed a great milestone – we wrapped up the vast majority of the 2D graphics in BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION! This means that all 85+ scenes, the conversational portraits, as well as the menu and item graphics are now complete.

It was an immense undertaking, but Nic and I are pleased to have done so on schedule. Focus can now be applied to the gameplay/puzzle hookup and cinematic implementation.

[b]
NEW SCREENSHOTS
[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33620429/b3c9c68336059289f0f2191f88ce338872955618.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33620429/cc1f50027026a073afb5321c02c7a75028ce68b5.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33620429/fb52fac32e613b3280b796fa6e6670a1b51ae4a9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33620429/d99873264d84f27f960d61b75aba578a12230fe4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33620429/f3113be9fba620d7b7d710981d3264df935bbb8f.jpg[/img]

In case you missed the news, Mick Gordon – the finest video game composer to wield a keyboard and amp – has joined our motley crew. Mick has produced some incredible musical tapestries for the world of DESOLATION and we can’t wait for you to be transported there, audibly and visually.

“Mick Gordon is a composer and sound designer whose compositions aim to transcend the perceptual boundary between music and its context.  Mick’s work considers the role of music as a translation of the world in which it exists rather than a simple accompaniment.  Through creativity, interpretation and collaboration he develops a meaningful exchange between the visual world and music culminating in the authorship of a unified original work of art.”

More: https://mick-gordon.com/

Follow Mick here: https://twitter.com/mick_gordon

You can hear a small snippet of his music for DESOLATION  here:
https://thebrotherhoodgames.com/blog/2019/03/march-2019-whats-news/

PLEASE WISHLIST AND SHARE! We will have a release discount so be sure to get on that List! :)

[b]-Chris & Nic[/b]
